title: Cosmetics
description: A badge, a frame, a profile banner and overlay themes — for the site and your stream only, nothing changes in the game. Bought with casings; seasonal ones come from the season track.
balanceHint: Casings can’t be bought or cashed out — only earned through challenges, tank levels and the season.

slotHints.badge: Shown next to your nickname on the profile and in leaderboards.
slotHints.frame: Outline around the nickname block on the profile.
slotHints.overlayTheme: Picked in the streamer studio. Work while Plus is active.
